entries.title: Claude Mythos or Fable 5 is trouble for SaaS businesses?
entries.summary: Claude Fable 5's ability to make software easy to build and access is seen as a growing threat to traditional SaaS businesses, as the barrier to creating custom software solutions continues to drop rapidly.

entries.title: Will AI Replace Engineers? 🧑‍💻
entries.summary: A 22-second YouTube Short posing the question 'Will AI Replace Engineers?' with no detailed content or argument presented. No substantive analysis is provided beyond the headline question.

entries.title: LUMEN: a browser shader studio with nine WebGL2 art modes that exports seamless loops to PNG, WebM
Do You Remember Me Before AI?
Claude Code Gets These 3 MCPs or It's Useless
entries.summary: The essential three-MCP starter stack for Claude Code: GitHub MCP for live repo, issue, and pull-request access; Notion or Linear MCP for real task specs; and Playwright MCP for browser-based build verification. This setup transforms Claude Code from a chatbot into a full coding agent.

entries.title: Build apps by voice for FREE? 🤯 Using Claude Code + N2 is a game changer!
entries.summary: The N2 API (Qwen 3.5-based, 262K context window, designed for agentic workflows) can be used as a free backend with Claude Code to build full applications via voice commands with live previews, eliminating API costs for agentic compute tasks.

entries.title: Comment "Tools" and I'll send you my full list 👇 Claude Chat vs Code vs Cowork
entries.summary: A clear routing guide for Claude surfaces: Claude Chat is best for brainstorming, writing, planning, and understanding complex topics; Claude Code is best for building apps, coding tasks, and deploying automations; Claude Cowork is best for sharing AI access across teams and running persistent tools.

entries.title: Emil Kowalski and Claude Code launch design tools to polish AI websites #emilkowalski #claudecode
entries.summary: Emil Kowalski introduced three design skills for AI-built websites: adding real motion with proper easing curves, using Impeccable's commands for refined typography and layout polish, and applying the Taste design system to teach AI models better visual principles. These address the most common AI website quality issues like overused gradients and the Inter font.

entries.title: Anthropic just dropped Claude Fable 5 this week #LevronLabs #AIAutomation #Anthropic #SmallBusiness
entries.summary: Levron Labs announces that Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5, framing it as a significant milestone for AI automation and small business use. The short clip provides no technical details beyond the announcement of the new model release.

entries.title: Are Companies Too Focused on Replacing People with AI Instead of Investing in Them?
entries.summary: A webinar titled "AI, People, and the Future of Work" (June 24th) poses the question of whether organizations are too focused on replacing employees with AI instead of investing in building their AI capabilities, hosted by Rocky Phoenix AI.

entries.title: Okara: The $99 CMO that handles everything #AI #MarketingTips
entries.summary: Okara is a $99/month AI CMO platform that deploys a team of autonomous agents for SEO, GEO, AI-written keyword-gap content, and Reddit/Hacker News community engagement — replacing marketing operations that previously cost over $14,000 per month.

entries.title: Improve: your best model plans, your cheapest model builds
entries.summary: shadcn released an open-source Claude Code skill called 'improve' that implements a tiered model workflow: a frontier model audits the codebase across nine quality dimensions and writes detailed execution plans, then cheaper models carry out the implementation steps. This pattern achieves frontier-quality direction at a fraction of the token cost, with slash commands like /improve, /improve plan, and /improve execute for the full workflow.

entries.title: Easiest vector-DB knowledge base: NotebookLM
entries.summary: Google NotebookLM can serve as a zero-setup vector database knowledge base for AI agents, handling multi-document synthesis without requiring RAG pipelines, Supabase vector DBs, or embedding configuration — covering 99% of agent memory use cases instantly.

entries.title: Everything I ate 3 days out from my Ironman
You Might Not Like AI, but China Does
entries.summary: South Korea deployed AI-based adaptive textbooks in 98% of elementary and middle schools by April 2025, with debate centering on whether AI tutoring reduces inequality (by replacing expensive $4,000/month cram schools) versus the American framing that it deepens it (rich families get human tutors plus AI). The video highlights how the same technology produces opposite conclusions across cultural and economic frames — Korean parents see equalization, American parents see widening divides.

entries.title: Comment “BRAIN” for the in-depth guide (the setup, the folder structure, and the exact prompts you
entries.summary: This short promotes an "AI second brain" built with Claude and Obsidian — a persistent local folder that remembers everything about you, your business, and your projects across sessions. The full guide (folder structure, setup, and exact prompts) is gated behind commenting 'BRAIN' on the video.

entries.title: The NEXT STAGE Of The AI Supercycle...
entries.summary: Investor Chris Camillo argues that the AI supercycle has moved beyond chips and infrastructure into an efficiency wave, where AI reduces costs rather than just enabling new capabilities. He suggests investors should be preparing to capitalize on this next phase of AI adoption.

entries.title: Anthropic just dropped Fable 5 and the performance jumps are wild. The agent encoding scor
entries.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 achieves +11 points on agent encoding benchmarks vs Claude Opus 4.8, with Stripe reporting months of engineering work compressed into days on a 50 million-line Ruby codebase. The model also demonstrates advanced strategic reasoning by beating complex games like Slay the Spire.

entries.title: We Premiered a Full AI Film in Cannes 🎬
entries.summary: Higgsfield AI produced a 95-minute action-fantasy feature film called Hell Grind using 15 filmmakers in 14 days, entirely generated with Higgsfield AI (powered by Seedance). The film premiered at Cannes 2026, marking a landmark moment for AI-generated feature-length cinema.

entries.title: Stop Using ChatGPT Like Everyone Else (Use These Secret Modes)
entries.summary: Marketing Mark shows how adding simple prefixes like ELI5, Socratic, and TL;DR before ChatGPT prompts unlocks dramatically different response styles. These mode prefixes change how the model reasons and presents answers, turning a generic AI response into a targeted, style-appropriate output.

entries.title: Claude enables pre-mortem analysis to spot hidden project risks early #claudeai #premortem #aitools
entries.summary: Claude enables pre-mortem project analysis by imagining a project has already failed, then working backward to identify hidden assumptions, weak execution points, and resource risks — surfacing problems before any resources are committed. This technique significantly improves project planning quality.

entries.title: How Monorepos vs Polyrepos works #177
entries.summary: A brief explainer comparing monorepo architecture (a single repository sharing infrastructure across services) to polyrepo setups, using the analogy of a continent sharing infrastructure vs separate countries.

entries.title: Gossip Protocol — Scale Without Coordinator in 60s  #systemdesign #coding #ai #software #scortier
entries.summary: A short explainer on the Gossip Protocol in distributed systems, showing how nodes in a cluster share state without a central coordinator — used by Cassandra for membership, Consul for health checks, and BitTorrent for peer discovery. Information spreads in log N rounds, making the approach resilient and massively scalable.

entries.title: AI Token Futures Trading is Coming and I'm Completely Confused Why
entries.summary: TechCrunch reported that AI token futures trading — treating AI compute tokens like gold or oil commodities — may be coming to financial markets, prompting skepticism about how such artificially created assets could be regulated or fairly priced. The creator argues the comparison to physical commodities is fundamentally flawed and the concept is ripe for market manipulation.

entries.title: Your Claude session costs tokens before you even type #claudecode #aitools #shorts
entries.summary: Every new Claude Code session preloads system prompt, skill files, and memory files into context before any user input — consuming tokens before a single message is typed. Using the /context command reveals exactly what is loaded and its token cost per session.

entries.title: The Three Virtues of Great Programmers
entries.summary: Laziness, impatience, and hubris are identified as the three core virtues of great programmers: laziness prevents unnecessary work, impatience drives automation of repetitive tasks, and hubris motivates writing high-quality code worth maintaining.

entries.title: Companies Are Using AI as an Excuse to Fire People Instead of Training Them
entries.summary: The tech industry is using AI as justification for mass layoffs instead of investing in upskilling employees, a shortsighted strategy that ignores AI's greatest value as a tool that amplifies human capabilities. Companies that train their teams to work alongside AI will gain a lasting competitive advantage over those that simply cut headcount.

entries.title: Claude built a model it says is too dangerous to release
entries.summary: Anthropic is said to have built a new model called Mythos that it has held back as too dangerous to release, drawing parallels to GPT-2's controversial 2019 withholding. The video teases details about the model's capabilities and speculates it could be the biggest Claude release since Fable 5.

entries.title: AI Already Passes as Human Better Than Real Humans (UC San Diego Study)
entries.summary: A UC San Diego study found that ChatGPT 4.5, equipped with the right persona prompts, outperforms real humans in Turing tests during live chat scenarios. The findings raise questions about online trust and digital authenticity as AI-generated text, images, and real-time translation become increasingly indistinguishable from human-produced content.

entries.title: GitHub Just Made a Big AI Coding Move
entries.summary: GitHub launched a new standalone Copilot app that lets developers choose any AI model provider rather than being locked into OpenAI models as with Codex. The feature is a significant differentiator for GitHub Copilot, though availability issues were reported at launch.

entries.title: training a neural network is not how the tutorials make it look #ai #neuralnetworks #deeplearning
entries.summary: A 46-second short suggesting that real neural network training looks different from what tutorials typically present, without providing specifics. A creator comment recommends Andrej Karpathy's 'Zero to Hero' YouTube series and building a personal learning roadmap covering calculus, statistics, and Python as foundations.

entries.title: ChatGPT Truth Mode
entries.summary: ChatGPT has introduced a 'Truth Mode' feature that actively pushes back against weak logic and challenges user assumptions rather than simply agreeing. The feature is presented as valuable for business, content creation, and decision-making, helping users identify blind spots in their thinking.

entries.title: Build Stunning Websites With Claude Code Using This Setup
entries.summary: A two-step Claude Code design setup combining the UIUXPRO MAX GitHub skill (50+ UI styles, 21 color palettes, 50 font pairings) with 21st.dev's Magic MCP Server transforms Claude Code's website output to include professional animations, glassmorphism, gradient layouts, and cinematic design immediately.

entries.title: Keyboard vs WisprFlow ai Follow @tankots42 & @wisprflow on IG
entries.summary: This short clip compares traditional keyboard input to WisprFlow AI, an AI-powered voice dictation tool. WisprFlow converts spoken words into clean, punctuated text across all applications using a hotkey-activated workflow.

entries.title: Why MCP Exists #Shorts
entries.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) extends the traditional API paradigm — where software tools have talked to each other for decades — to create a standardized way for AI models to natively request data and actions from other software. It's why CRMs, email tools, and task managers can now connect seamlessly to AI agents.

entries.title: How to Actually Learn to Code
entries.summary: Tech With Tim argues that learners should skip mastering all of Python and instead build focused AI projects right away to develop real skills faster. The key insight is that tutorials put learners in passive consumption mode — shipping small AI apps builds the actual problem-solving muscle.

entries.title: Anthropic launches Claude finance plugins automating Wall Street analysis fast #anthropic #claude
entries.summary: Anthropic has launched finance plugins for Claude that automate tasks traditionally performed by Wall Street analysts, including Financial Analysis, Equity Research, Earnings Reviewer, and Market Researcher. These plugins require only minutes to set up and can reduce hours of manual investment research to under a minute per task.

entries.title: Universal cable for 8K, 192Gbps data, and 500W power.
Higgsfield Soul 2.0 is here to surprise you 🧩 #aiimages #higgsfield #soul
entries.summary: Higgsfield AI launches Soul 2.0, an image generation update featuring over 20 curated style presets and near-zero prompting requirements. The release includes a promotional offer of up to 10,000 free generation credits for new users.

entries.title: Build Stunning Websites with Claude Code 🔥 #AI #WebDev #NoCode #coding
entries.summary: Claude Code is being used to build professional websites with AI-powered development, enabling both beginners and developers to create sites without complex setup. The video's creator shared a GitHub skill package — UI UX Pro Max (91k stars) — that injects professional design intelligence into Claude Code with 161 reasoning rules and 67 UI styles across 13+ frontend stacks.

entries.title: Ponytail: a Claude Code skill that asks "should we build this at all?" before touching the keyboard
entries.summary: Ponytail is an open-source Claude Code plugin with 7.5k GitHub stars that forces AI agents to reason like a lazy senior developer before writing any code: it checks YAGNI, standard library alternatives, existing dependencies, and one-liner solutions first. This approach achieves 80-94% less code output, 3-6× faster delivery, and 47-77% cost reduction.

entries.title: AirLLM enables local 70B AI #airllm #flashattention #llama3
entries.summary: AirLLM is an open-source Python library that lets developers run 70B-parameter models like LLaMA 3.3 on consumer hardware (MacBook, gaming PC) by streaming model layers from disk one at a time instead of loading the entire model into memory. Comments note a significant speed tradeoff — roughly 1 token per second — making it practical primarily for offline batch jobs and privacy-first research rather than interactive use.

entries.title: The Fastest Way to Get Good at Coding
I Built an Entire Course Platform Inside Claude
entries.summary: Demonstrates using Claude to build a complete course hosting platform including student dashboards, learning curricula, and educational experiences — showcasing how the gap between beginner AI use and expert-level AI application continues to widen.

entries.title: Comment "Fable" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude just dropped the most powerful AI model
entries.summary: A 49-second promotional short making exaggerated claims that 'Fable 5' is a secret government-grade Anthropic model now publicly available — these claims appear fabricated or heavily embellished. The video is comment-gated ('comment Fable to get the guide') with no verifiable guide link available in comments.

entries.title: One shared memory across Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini (Hindsight)
entries.summary: Hindsight provides a cloud-hosted (also available locally) memory database with an MCP server that unifies memory across Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and any MCP-compatible AI tool. Three operations — retain (store), recall (pull), and reflect (synthesize) — eliminate the problem of context being siloed in individual AI apps.

entries.title: Trae IDE enables router-based home security without cameras #traeide #drewview #hometech
entries.summary: Trae IDE was used to build a router-based home security app that detects movement by analyzing changes in Wi-Fi signal patterns caused by people passing through a space — no cameras required. AI agents in Trae IDE autonomously built, debugged, and deployed the solution.

entries.title: China Forced Meta to Reverse a $2 Billion Deal  #meta   #manusai
entries.summary: Meta's $2 billion acquisition of Manus AI was reversed after Beijing intervened with investigations and travel restrictions on the founder, framing AI talent as a strategic national asset. The incident highlights the intensifying US-China AI rivalry, where governments are actively blocking cross-border AI talent and technology transfers.

entries.title: Claude launched Fable 5. But has anyone checked its price? #claude #fable5 #ai
entries.summary: Claude Fable 5 is priced at 2× the cost of Claude Opus 4.8, which itself was already considered expensive. This pricing dynamic makes careful model selection critical for high-volume agentic applications.

entries.title: These 3 AI Tools Feel ILLEGAL 😳
entries.summary: Gamma AI for instant presentations, NotebookLM for document-based learning, and Perplexity AI for intelligent search are highlighted as AI tools that feel almost too powerful to be free — useful for students, creators, and productivity-focused professionals.

entries.title: The best AI tools to use in 2026 👇 Writing: Claude Learning something new: NotebookLM Creating
entries.summary: A quick 2026 AI tool selection guide names Claude for writing, NotebookLM for learning and breaking down topics, Lovable for creating websites, ChatGPT for ideas and image generation, and Cytd.ai for AI-powered monetization workflows.

entries.title: I built a skill that turns any video into an agent skill
entries.summary: A Claude Code skill uses Apify's scraping API to automatically process any video or social post URL — extracting transcript, comments, and description — then enriches it with web research and converts it into a concrete actionable skill file for AI agents.

entries.title: When I lock up the Darce choke you gotta tap #mma #ufc #fighter #sparring #sparring
Comment "Finance" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude just killed the finance industry
entries.summary: Anthropic's Claude is being used for three high-value finance workflows: automated stock research that pulls news and analyst ratings, Excel financial model building for stock valuation, and earnings call analysis to validate investment theses. These capabilities replace services that Wall Street analysts traditionally charge thousands of dollars to provide.

entries.title: Claude Just Killed n8n
entries.summary: A short video claiming Claude's automation capabilities make n8n workflow automation tools obsolete, though no specific technical comparison or evidence is provided in the title-only content.

entries.title: World's First Ever AI Feature Film in Cannes!
entries.summary: 15 filmmakers created 'Hell Grind,' a 95-minute action-fantasy feature film entirely using Higgsfield AI in 14 days, premiering at the Cannes Film Festival — described as the world's first AI feature film to screen at a major film festival.

entries.title: I Paste Viral Videos Into Claude and It Does This
entries.summary: Paste any YouTube video link into Claude and run /analyze to instantly get the hook, format, and structure of viral content broken down. You can batch-analyze dozens of viral videos at once to spot trends before anyone else — a fast social media research workflow for content creators.

entries.title: How to prompt AI like a pro
entries.summary: Effective AI prompting requires giving the model four key elements every time, though the specific elements are not spelled out in the available short video description.

entries.title: My Claude Code improves its own skills overnight: here's how
entries.summary: Every Claude Code session stores a complete JSONL transcript in the local Claude folder, creating a paper trail for how skills influence agent behavior. Running an auto-research loop where one agent grades another's transcript and rewrites the skill overnight enables continuous self-improvement of AI coding setups.
